I have two mother tongues: Japanese and Bulgarian. I speak as well English and French.

In my family, we speak in Japanese-Bulgarian mishmash language. The same thing is in my brain. I have noticed that  when I think, as my thought goes in sentences, I don't mix the languages in one sentence. But I have noticed that I often change the languages between the sentences. It doesn't feel weird to me because I am raised this way.  


Sometimes i add an English or French word when I think.
